title: Live Electrical Work Permit
name: Live Electrical Work Permit
description: High-risk permit for exceptional electrical work where conductors or parts remain live. It requires documented justification, competent persons, defined boundaries and emergency arrangements.

sections.title: JUSTIFICATION AND AUTHORISATION
items: Dead working has been considered first
The reason work cannot reasonably be carried out dead is documented
The persons carrying out the work are competent for the task
The work method, equipment and precautions are suitable for live work
A suitably authorised person has approved the exceptional live-work arrangement

fields.label: Why Dead Working Is Not Reasonably Practicable / Appropriate

sections.title: LIVE WORK CONTROLS
items: Live parts and adjacent live parts are clearly identified
Safe approach / working boundaries are established
Insulated tools and suitable test equipment are available
Screens, barriers or insulating protection are fitted where required
Arc flash / fault-energy risks are considered
Access is restricted to authorised persons
A second competent person / standby arrangement is provided where the risk assessment requires it

sections.title: EMERGENCY AND CLOSE-OUT
items: Emergency isolation arrangements are known and accessible
First-aid / electrical rescue arrangements are available
Work stops if conditions differ from the approved method
Covers, guards and enclosures are restored before handback
The circuit / equipment final state is recorded
